title: Harden play-loop canon, audit, and continuity after p4vd
description:
Problem

The first playtest after campaign overlay canon landed shows real p4vd progress: consequential lore can be recorded with record_world_fact, retrieved later through world_query, and exposed to audit with canon-tier and visibility metadata.

However, normal play is still too brittle. The DM/audit/tool loop now fails at the integration boundary between module canon, campaign overlay lore, recent scene continuity, and descriptive consistency.

Observed playtest pattern

Session: session-mqskv6co-pdsj5x
Campaign: The Hollow Beneath Emberfall
Scope note: ignore the character creation section; b69j is still in progress.

Key observations:
- The system successfully recorded and retrieved the Emberfall incident as overlay lore after retry.
- Warden Sela / Emberfall module-canon discovery was brittle unless exact IDs were used.
- The auditor did not consistently treat recent accepted dialogue as scene-local evidence.
- Retry repair sometimes fixed one missing tool/evidence issue but exposed another, causing player-visible hard failure.
- The auditor classified set_plot_flag as a disallowed tool in a case where the real problem was insufficient evidence / wrong tool choice.
- The current canon hierarchy risks dropping stable descriptive details as "just color", creating continuity contradictions on later revisits.

Goal

Harden the play loop so Eshyra can combine:
- module canon
- campaign overlay lore
- recent scene facts
- stable continuity dressing
- audit evidence
- repair/retry behavior

without hard-failing ordinary follow-up conversation or creating immersion-breaking descriptive contradictions.

Non-goal

Do not address character creation issues here. Those remain under b69j.
close_reason: All five hardening tasks landed through PRs #292, #294, #295, #297, and #298.
